title: M3 Pop-out chat pane in the newsroom for signed-in editors
description: A chat pane any signed-in editor can open from anywhere in the newsroom, docked or popped out, using the Chatticus client components. Auth bridges the newsroom's Cognito session to the chat turn API so the agent acts as that editor. Transcripts are kept per editor and site.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Chat delivery milestone completed under PPY-0d18a6: existing newsroom session, real reply, retained private history and integrated mobile navigation verified on production; user also confirmed response. Remaining validation limits: physical iPhone Safari keyboard and live second-editor isolation not exercised (controlled isolation regressions pass). Broader epic scope/status is left open for successor review; no claim of all-editorial-tools capability. Handoff: docs/handoffs/2026-10-27-private-newsroom-chat.md. Engineering ownership ended at user request.
